answer: Require every new agent to present a certified prosthetist registration earned through supervised clinical fittings and a board exam, verified against a health registry. Like a lotus rooted in a lagoon, the credential grows only with real work: each fake identity needs one real clinician, one supervised caseload, and one registration, costing roughly 90 supervised fittings and an exam fee per fake. No shortcut stands on that ledge, so ten fakes cost ten full registrations and the price climbs with each extra fake.
